details.publicNotes:
A chionad shadow is the faded remnant of a chionad who has lost the connection to their mountain home, often because something devastated the mountain. This makes them particularly foreboding, since few disasters can separate a chionad from their frozen summit beyond drastic climate change, tectonic upheaval, or the rampage of some titanic beast.

Unable to strike back against the massive and often nameless forces that ravaged their home, the chionad shadow turns their despair and hatred toward all other living things. Their inner light having dimmed, the chionad shadow fights with darkness and bitter cold, stalking barren mountains, flooded polar coasts, and dying forests. They seek lost travelers and wayward creatures to mislead and drag them down to an inglorious and inevitable end. They reserve their bitterest hatred for nymph wanderers, who lead fulfilling lives without their wards. Whether they kill the wanderers immediately or attempt to extract their secrets first, chionad shadows can't bear a wanderer's presence for long. Still, idealistic wanderers sometimes seek out chionad shadows in the hope that they can help these bitter fey find peace with their new existences.

Even when a chionad shadow finds their way to a suitably snowy mountain, that doesn't mean they can establish a new mystical bond there. Failed attempts only increase their sense of loss, driving them to hunt and divide even the smallest of creatures and upsetting the natural balance of the already unforgiving environment.

From afar, chionad shadows bear some resemblance to their former selves, cloaked in white and heralded by a keening melody. But their gray wings drip foul water, and their icy skin is webbed with cracks. When their music fades, it leaves behind a discordant and lonely echo.

Auroral Shadows

Very rarely, a chionad becomes a shadow not when they lose connection with their bonded mountain, but rather when a change in their planet's magnetosphere causes the aurora itself to fade from the night sky. Chionad shadows created this way are just as bitter as those who have lost connection with their mountain, but such a phenomenon is particularly tragic, as it means that not just one shadow, but many, have been created all at once. Even if the planet's aurora is somehow restored, the shadows created by the interruption abide, unable to reforge the bond with their mountain peak and forevermore on guard against new chionads who would seek to take their place.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 64/140/250 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (slashing), armor (light, medium), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Stealth, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, darkness, energy resistant (cold, vitality), ice, mind, mind shield, music, sensory (darkvision), spells (Primal: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}, @UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-spells.JCQxDEB0CFIoveu6]{Falling Icicles}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]{Sleep}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals}), strength, throwing, wild, winged

description.value:
You conjure a cluster of sharpened icicles in the air before letting them fall. All creatures in the area take 1d6 piercing damage and 1d6 cold damage, with a basic Reflex save. Creatures that fail the saving throw are frozen 2.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 piercing and 1d6 cold.

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

An orb of biting cold coalesces around your target, freezing its body. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target also gains weakness 1 to bludgeoning until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.DdqWMj7cuf4S1bgr]{Spell Effect: Frostbite}

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 and the weakness on a critical failure increases by 1.

Each creature in the area becomes drowsy and might fall asleep. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall Unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall Prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

When the chionad shadow hits a creature with their claw or prismatic shadow Strike, the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. Whatever the result, the creature is temporarily immune to the same chionad shadow's fateful impact for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and drained 1 for 1 hour.

The chionad shadow unleashes their inner darkness and briefly becomes a vision of loss and futility. All creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. Creatures that fail the saving throw can't treat any other creature as an ally or be treated as an ally by any other creature for 1 minute.
